local users = tool('list_users', {})
local user_ids = {}
for _, u in ipairs(users) do
  user_ids[#user_ids + 1] = u.id
end

local dates = {'2026-06-15','2026-06-16','2026-06-17','2026-06-18','2026-06-19'}

-- Collect busy intervals per user per date
local busy = {}
for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
  busy[uid] = {}
  for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
    local r = tool('get_availability', {user_id = uid, date = d})
    busy[uid][d] = r.busy or {}
  end
end

-- Helper: parse HH:MM to minutes from midnight
local function to_min(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

-- Helper: check if [start_m, end_m) overlaps any busy interval on that date for a user
local function is_free(uid, date, start_m, end_m)
  for _, iv in ipairs(busy[uid][date]) do
    local b_start = to_min(iv.start)
    local b_end = to_min(iv['end'])
    if start_m < b_end and end_m > b_start then
      return false
    end
  end
  return true
end

-- Candidate starts: 09:00, 09:30, ..., 16:00 (so end <= 17:00)
local candidates = {}
for m = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do
  candidates[#candidates + 1] = m
end

local function fmt(m)
  return string.format('%02d:%02d', math.floor(m/60), m%60)
end

for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for _, start_m in ipairs(candidates) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(uid, d, start_m, end_m) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      local start_iso = d .. 'T' .. fmt(start_m) .. ':00Z'
      local end_iso = d .. 'T' .. fmt(end_m) .. ':00Z'
      return {start = start_iso, ['end'] = end_iso, users = user_ids, busy = busy}
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids, busy = busy}
